name: Build a lesson from explanation to practice and a quiz
why: One lesson built the way this kit builds every lesson: explanation, worked example, practice and a check.

name: Check a lesson before teaching it
why: A pre-launch review that finds barriers and adds quick checks, useful before storyboard sign-off.

name: Adapt a lesson for different access needs
why: Keeps the learning goal while removing barriers, the same aim as the kit's accessibility review prompt.

name: Make a lesson narration learners can follow
why: A spoken script with a text companion, matching the kit's rule that every narration has a transcript.

name: Recall quiz writer
why: Quick recall questions at three levels to space practice between modules, alongside the scenario-based knowledge checks.

name: Monthly course lesson keeper
why: Finds stale or confusing lessons each month, the upkeep step in the customer academy workflow.

name: Price a course or ebook and write its launch emails
why: Honest pricing and launch emails for a paid course, to pair with a course outline built from this kit.

name: PowerPoint accessibility reviewer
why: Checks slide titles, reading order and alt text in decks before they become e-learning.

name: Video caption maker in your brand font
why: Timed caption groups and a subtitle file, a companion to the training video script and captions skill.

name: Make onboarding instructions match the product
why: Fixes first-use instructions that name moved or missing buttons, the accuracy check every academy lesson needs.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Re-checks a course site for accessibility gaps each quarter after launch.

name: Skill breakdown teaching planner
why: Breaks a skill into beginner steps with a common mistake for each, a fast start for goals and distractors.
